name: @map-harness/spatial-scale
description: Distributed-scale spatial data channel: the versioned `spatial-scale@1` contract binding an immutable chunked object provider (GeoParquet-style row-group chunks with per-chunk digests, range/tile/query reads), the resource budgets that keep every read and scan bounded, the worker-process plane with backpressure, cancel-to-quiescence, retry, and staged artifact publication, the scan record rebuilt from session-cited parts, and the fixed-workload benchmark with measured latency/memory/scan/concurrency/recovery thresholds. A pure library the scale tools consume — no host row.
